subject: DI03000141

intro_text.en: Diagram-first notes: identify parts, understand construction, follow working and practise only the syllabus numericals.
intro_text.gu: પહેલાં labelled diagram, પછી parts, Construction અને step-by-step Working. Syllabus પ્રમાણે જ numericals.

h.en: 2.1.1 Cam system: function, parts and applications
h.gu: 2.1.1 Cam system: Function, Parts અને Applications

body.en:
A cam is a shaped driver that gives a prescribed displacement to a follower through direct contact. Construction includes cam and shaft, follower, guide or pivot, contact tip/roller, and often a return spring. Working: as the cam turns, its changing contact geometry lifts the follower; spring or another positive constraint maintains contact during return.

Applications include IC-engine valve operation, automatic feed mechanisms and packaging machines. Motion is set by the cam profile, not by the follower copying the cam radius at every angle. A roller centre follows the pitch curve, not the physical cam surface.
body.gu:
Cam એ shaped driver છે, જે direct contact થી follower ને prescribed motion આપે. Parts: cam/shaft, follower, guide/pivot, tip/roller અને ઘણીવાર spring. Cam ફરતાં profile follower ને lift આપે; return દરમિયાન spring/contact constraint જરૂરી.

IC-engine valves, automatic feed અને packaging માં ઉપયોગ. Roller centre pitch curve અનુસરે, actual cam surface નહિ.

body.en:
Cams: radial/disc, cylindrical/barrel, wedge/translating, face and conjugate forms. A radial cam is profiled in a plane normal to its shaft; a barrel cam uses a groove around a cylinder. Followers: knife-edge, roller, flat-faced or spherical-faced by contacting surface; reciprocating or oscillating by motion; in-line or offset by line of travel.

Knife-edge is a geometric teaching ideal with high local wear. Roller reduces sliding but needs a bearing and space. Flat-faced followers provide broad contact but the face width and cam curvature must be checked.
body.gu:
Cams: radial/disc, cylindrical/barrel, wedge/translating, face અને conjugate. Radial profile shaft ને normal plane માં હોય; barrel પર groove હોય. Followers contact મુજબ knife-edge, roller, flat, spherical; motion મુજબ reciprocating/oscillating; axis મુજબ in-line/offset.

Knife-edge ideal teaching model છે; wear વધુ. Roller sliding ઘટાડે પણ bearing જોઈએ. Flat face માટે width અને curvature check જરૂરી.

h.en: 2.1.3 Drawing terminology: base circle, pitch curve and pressure angle
h.gu: 2.1.3 Drawing terms: Base circle, Pitch curve અને Pressure angle

body.en:
Base circle is the smallest circle tangent to the actual cam profile, centred on the camshaft. Trace point is the knife tip, roller centre, or specified follower reference point. Pitch curve is the locus of that trace point in the inverse-motion construction; for a roller it is outside the physical profile. Prime circle is the smallest concentric circle tangent to the pitch curve.

Lift is maximum follower travel; dwell is an interval with zero follower displacement change. Pressure angle is between follower motion direction and the contact-force normal. Large pressure angle increases guide side force. Roller radius, base size and curvature must prevent undercutting.
body.gu:
Base circle actual cam profile ને tangent થતું smallest shaft-centred circle. Trace point knife tip/roller centre/reference point; તેનો inverse-motion locus pitch curve છે. Roller માટે pitch curve actual surface બહાર હોય. Prime circle pitch curve ને tangent smallest concentric circle.

Lift=max travel; dwell માં displacement બદલાતું નથી. Pressure angle=motion direction અને contact normal વચ્ચે angle. વધારે angle થી guide side force વધે; undercutting avoid કરવું.

body.en:
During rise through cam angle beta and lift h, displacement y=h theta/beta. Divide beta into equal angles and h into equal displacements; joining the points gives a straight line. Return is a descending straight line, and dwell is horizontal.

With constant cam speed, follower velocity is constant inside the rise but jumps at its start/end, implying impulsive ideal acceleration. This makes the simple law unsuitable for many high-speed cams without transition shaping. The displacement graph uses cam angle horizontally and follower displacement vertically, not cam radius.
body.gu:
Rise angle beta અને lift h માટે y=h theta/beta. Beta ના equal angle divisions અને lift ના equal divisions જોડવાથી straight line મળે. Return descending line; dwell horizontal.

Constant cam speed પર rise અંદર velocity constant પણ endpoints પર sudden change થાય, એટલે ideal acceleration impulse. High-speed માટે transitions વગર યોગ્ય નથી. Graph: horizontal cam angle, vertical follower displacement.

h.en: 2.2.2 Simple harmonic motion: graphical and analytical construction

body.en:
For SHM rise, y=(h/2)[1−cos(pi theta/beta)]. Graphically draw a semicircle of diameter h, divide its angle equally, project the corresponding ordinate levels onto equally divided rise-angle stations, and join smoothly. For return use y=(h/2)[1+cos(pi phi/beta)] where phi starts at return.

Velocity is zero at rise endpoints and maximum near mid-rise. Acceleration is finite but changes abruptly at a dwell boundary; SHM does not automatically eliminate all dynamic shock. Use the law specified in the problem rather than assuming every cam uses SHM.
body.gu:
SHM rise: y=(h/2)[1−cos(pi theta/beta)]. Graphically h diameter નો semicircle બનાવી equal angular divisions ના levels, rise-angle ની equal stations પર project કરો અને smooth curve જોડો. Return માટે plus-cos law, phi return થી ગણો.

Endpoints પર velocity zero, mid-rise પાસે maximum. Dwell boundary પર acceleration sudden change હોઈ શકે; SHM માં બધો shock ગાયબ થતો નથી.

body.en:
Let u=theta/beta. First half rise: y=2h u². Second half: y=h[1−2(1−u)²]. The first half has constant positive acceleration and the second equal negative acceleration; the curves meet at half lift and half angle with continuous velocity.

Graphically divide each half rise into equal time/angle intervals and use square-number displacement proportions (1,4,9,...) within each half, reversing the construction for retardation. Return uses a mirrored fall law. Acceleration jumps at boundaries and at mid-rise, so this is not a jerk-free motion law.
body.gu:
u=theta/beta. First half: y=2h u²; second half: y=h[1−2(1−u)²]. First half constant acceleration અને second half retardation; midpoint પર h/2 displacement અને continuous velocity.

Graphical method માં દરેક half ના equal angle intervals માટે square-number proportions 1,4,9,... લો; retardation માટે reverse construction. Acceleration boundaries/midpoint પર jump થાય, એટલે jerk-free નથી.

body.en:
1. Write base radius, lift, follower type/size, offset, direction, rise/dwell/return angles and motion law. Check the angles total 360 degrees. 2. Draw the full displacement diagram with enough subdivisions. 3. Draw shaft centre, base circle and follower axis.

4. Imagine the cam stationary and rotate the follower positions opposite the actual cam direction. Transfer the correct displacement at each angle. 5. Construct the physical envelope according to knife, roller or flat face. 6. Show rotation arrow, contact at a reference position, all dimensions and clear labels. A curve through arbitrary lifted radii is not a universal solution for offset or flat followers.
body.gu:
1. Base radius, lift, follower type/size, offset, rotation, motion law અને rise/dwell/return angles લખો; total 360° check કરો. 2. Full displacement diagram બનાવો. 3. Centre, base circle અને follower axis દોરો.

4. Cam fixed માની follower positions ને actual cam rotation ની opposite direction માં ફેરવો. 5. દરેક position પર displacement transfer કરી follower-specific envelope બનાવો. 6. Dimensions, arrows અને labels મૂકો. બધા follower માટે lifted radial points જોડવા યોગ્ય નથી.

body.en:
Construction: draw the initial follower axis through the cam centre, touching the base circle. In inverse rotation, each follower station lies along a radius; mark Rb+y at the corresponding angle. Join these tip points smoothly; pitch curve and profile coincide.

Worked drawing data used here: Rb=40 mm, lift=20 mm; SHM rise 120°, dwell 60°, SHM return 120°, dwell 60°. At half rise, theta=60° and y=10 mm, so the tip radius is 50 mm. The plotted cams rotate clockwise. The shown profile is generated from this stated law; it is not a tracing from an actual component.
body.gu:
Construction: follower axis centre માંથી base circle ને touch કરે. Inverse rotation માં દરેક radial station પર Rb+y distance મૂકી smooth tip locus દોરો; એ જ profile/pitch curve.

Example: Rb=40 mm, lift=20 mm, SHM rise120°, dwell60°, return120°, dwell60°. Half rise theta60° પર y=10 mm એટલે radius50 mm. Plotted cam clockwise ફરે છે. Diagram stated law પરથી calculated છે, actual component tracing નથી.

body.en:
Construction: draw an offset circle radius e and an initial follower line tangent to it. Its initial contact with base circle gives y0=sqrt(Rb²−e²), not Rb. Rotate each follower line oppositely around the cam centre while maintaining its tangent distance e; mark travel y along that line from the corresponding base position. Join knife-tip points.

For Rb=40 mm and e=10 mm, y0=38.73 mm. A rise of 10 mm places the tip at (e, y0+10) in its unrotated follower coordinates, not at a radial distance Rb+10. Left/right offset and rotation direction affect the asymmetric profile.
body.gu:
Construction: radius e નો offset circle દોરી તેની tangent follower line લો. Base contact axial distance y0=sqrt(Rb²−e²), Rb નહિ. Inverse rotation માં દરેક follower line centre થી e distance જાળવે; તે line પર base position થી travel y મૂકો.

Rb40, e10 માટે y0=38.73 mm. 10 mm rise માટે unrotated coordinates (10,48.73), radial Rb+10 નહિ. Offset side અને rotation profile બદલે.

body.en:
Construction: with roller radius rr, the initial roller-centre radius is Rb+rr. At each in-line inverse station, mark centre radius Rb+rr+y. Draw circles of radius rr around these centres; the smooth inner envelope is the cam profile. The centre locus is the pitch curve.

For the shown Rb=40, rr=8, lift20 example, base-dwell centre radius is 48 mm and half-rise centre radius is 58 mm. Do not simply join the roller centres or subtract rr radially everywhere: contact normal need not point toward the shaft centre. Check local curvature to avoid undercutting.
body.gu:
Construction: initial roller-centre radius Rb+rr. દરેક inverse station પર Rb+rr+y મૂકો, centres પર rr circles દોરો અને inner smooth envelope લો. Centre locus pitch curve છે.

Rb40, rr8 example માં base centre48 mm અને half-rise58 mm. Roller centres જોડવા નહિ; દરેક જગ્યાએ radial rr subtract પણ નહિ, કારણ contact normal radial હોવું જરૂરી નથી. Curvature/undercutting check કરો.

body.en:
Construction: follower axis is offset e. Initial roller-centre axial distance is sqrt((Rb+rr)²−e²). Rotate the offset line in inverse motion, add each displacement along it and locate the roller centre. Draw roller circles and obtain their inner envelope.

At Rb40, rr8 and e10 mm, initial axial distance is sqrt(2204)=46.95 mm. The pitch point and contact point are different. For accurate CAD plotting, offset the pitch curve by rr along its inward local normal; a fixed radial subtraction gives the wrong surface. Verify a continuous tangent envelope without cusps.
body.gu:
Construction: offset e માટે initial centre distance sqrt((Rb+rr)²−e²). Offset line ને inverse rotate કરી તે પર displacement ઉમેરો. Centres પર roller circles દોરી inner envelope લો.

Rb40, rr8, e10 mm માટે axial distance46.95 mm. Pitch point અને contact point અલગ છે. CAD માં local inward normal પર rr offset લો; radial subtraction ખોટું. Envelope continuous અને cusp વગર check કરો.

body.en:
Construction: initial face is a straight line perpendicular to the follower axis and tangent to the base circle. For each inverse angle, rotate the complete face orientation and shift it by the required lift along the corresponding follower axis. The smooth envelope tangent to these face lines is the cam profile.

Do not join the midpoints of the face lines: the contact point moves sideways across the face. For the example Rb40 and SHM lift20, the profile is the envelope with support distance Rb+y. Adequate face width and suitable cam curvature are essential; the sketch does not certify a production design.
body.gu:
Construction: initial flat face follower axis ને perpendicular અને base circle ને tangent હોય. દરેક inverse angle પર face orientation rotate કરી axis direction માં lift ઉમેરો. આ face lines ને tangent smooth envelope cam profile છે.

Face midpoints જોડવા નહિ; contact point face પર sideways સરકે. Example માં support distance Rb+y. Adequate face width અને suitable curvature જરૂરી; sketch production-design approval નથી.

h.en: 2.3.7 Flat-faced follower: with offset and finite face width
h.gu: 2.3.7 Flat-faced Follower: With Offset અને Face Width

body.en:
Construction: draw the translated follower axis e from the shaft centre but keep the flat face perpendicular to that axis. Rotate and translate the complete face lines in inverse motion, then form the tangent envelope. The graphical method is the same line-envelope method, not a roller-circle construction.

For an ideal infinitely wide flat face with the same lift law, changing axis offset does not change its supporting-line envelope: it changes where the contact lies relative to the follower axis. Real finite faces must be wide enough to include that contact throughout the cycle. The two flat-profile examples deliberately show the same ideal profile but different follower axes.
body.gu:
Construction: follower axis ને centre થી e offset કરો; face axis ને perpendicular જ રહે. Inverse motion માં આખી face line rotate/translate કરી tangent envelope લો; roller circles ની method નહિ.

Ideal infinitely wide flat face માટે same lift law હોય તો offset થી line-envelope profile બદલાતી નથી; contact ની axis સામે position બદલાય. Real finite face પૂરતી પહોળી જોઈએ. બંને diagrams માં ideal profile same પરંતુ follower axis અલગ દર્શાવ્યાં છે.

h.en: 2.3.8 Profile sheet checks and supervised practical

body.en:
Before submitting: check base circle, prime/pitch construction where applicable, rotation direction, e and rr dimensions, all rise/dwell/return stations, smooth joins and follower contact at several positions. A smaller step interval improves the drawn envelope; a displacement diagram alone is not a cam profile.

Syllabus practical: prepare a no-offset sheet with knife/roller followers, and an offset sheet with knife/flat followers, using teacher-supplied data. This package additionally includes an offset roller and an in-line flat illustration. Never rotate a powered exposed cam by hand; demonstrate on an isolated model under supervision.
body.gu:
Submit પહેલાં base circle, pitch construction, rotation arrow, e/rr, બધાં angular stations, smooth joins અને અલગ positions પર contact check કરો. Small steps થી envelope સુધરે. Displacement diagram પોતે cam profile નથી.

Practical માં teacher data થી no-offset knife/roller અને offset knife/flat sheets તૈયાર કરો. અહીં વધારાના offset roller/in-line flat પણ છે. Powered cam ને હાથથી rotate ન કરવો; isolated model પર supervision રાખો.

items.f:
u = theta / beta
UV: y=hu
SHM: y=h(1−cos(pi u))/2
UAR: y=2hu² (u≤0.5); y=h[1−2(1−u)²] (u≥0.5)

terms.en: Use consistent angular units inside trigonometric functions.
terms.gu: Trigonometric functions માં consistent angular units લો.

terms.en: Measure follower travel along its line, not radially.
terms.gu: Travel follower line પર માપો; radially નહિ.

q.en: What does a cam prescribe?
q.gu: Cam શું prescribe કરે?

q.en: Name three contact forms.
q.gu: ત્રણ follower contact forms?

q.en: What is dwell?
q.gu: Dwell શું?

a.en: Cam-angle interval with no change in follower displacement.
a.gu: Follower displacement બદલાયા વગરનો cam-angle interval.

q.en: What is lift?
q.gu: Lift શું?

a.en: Maximum follower travel from its base position.
a.gu: Base position થી maximum follower travel.

q.en: What is the pitch curve for a roller?
q.gu: Roller ની pitch curve?

a.en: Inverse-motion locus of the roller centre.
a.gu: Inverse motion માં roller centre નો locus.

q.en: Why inverse rotation?
q.gu: Inverse rotation કેમ?

a.en: To construct stationary-cam geometry while moving follower positions oppositely.
a.gu: Cam fixed માની follower positions opposite ફેરવી geometry દોરવા.

q.en: What graph represents uniform-velocity rise?
q.gu: Uniform-velocity rise graph?

q.en: Does SHM have zero velocity at rise ends?
q.gu: SHM rise ends પર velocity zero?

a.en: Yes, for the standard rise law.

q.en: How is a roller profile obtained?
q.gu: Roller profile કેવી રીતે મળે?

a.en: Inner envelope of roller circles at pitch-curve stations.
a.gu: Pitch stations પર roller circles ની inner envelope.

q.en: Can flat-face midpoints be joined as the cam?
q.gu: Flat-face midpoints જોડવાથી cam બને?

a.en: No; construct the envelope of the face lines.
a.gu: ના; face lines ની envelope લેવી.

q.en: What does offset mean?
q.gu: Offset નો અર્થ?

a.en: Perpendicular distance between shaft centre and follower line of travel.
a.gu: Shaft centre અને follower travel line વચ્ચે perpendicular distance.

q.en: Why check pressure angle?
q.gu: Pressure angle કેમ check?

a.en: Large values increase follower guide side load.
a.gu: વધુ angle થી follower guide side load વધે.

q.en: Define cam, follower, base circle, pitch curve, lift and dwell.
q.gu: Cam, Follower, Base circle, Pitch curve, Lift અને Dwell વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.

q.en: Classify cams and followers with applications and sketches.
q.gu: Cams/Followers sketches અને applications સાથે classify કરો.

q.en: Construct rise displacement diagrams for uniform velocity, SHM and uniform acceleration-retardation.
q.gu: Uniform velocity, SHM અને Uniform acceleration-retardation ના rise diagrams દોરો.

q.en: Explain velocity and acceleration limitations of the three motion laws.
q.gu: ત્રણ motion laws ની velocity/acceleration limitations સમજાવો.

q.en: Draw an in-line knife-edge cam: Rb40 mm, lift20 mm, SHM rise120°, dwell60°, SHM return120°, dwell60°; clockwise rotation.
q.gu: આ data માટે in-line knife-edge cam દોરો: Rb40, lift20 mm; SHM rise120°, dwell60°, return120°, dwell60°; clockwise.

q.en: For the preceding data draw an in-line roller profile with roller radius8 mm.
q.gu: પહેલાના data માટે roller radius8 mm વાળો in-line profile દોરો.

q.en: For the same motion draw a knife-edge profile with 10 mm right offset.
q.gu: Same motion માટે 10 mm right offset knife-edge profile દોરો.

q.en: For the same data construct an offset roller profile with rr8 mm and e10 mm.
q.gu: Same data માટે rr8 mm અને e10 mm offset roller profile દોરો.

q.en: Explain graphical construction for flat-faced followers with and without offset.
q.gu: Flat-faced followers ના with/without offset graphical constructions સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain pressure angle, undercutting and finite flat-face width checks.
q.gu: Pressure angle, Undercutting અને finite face-width checks સમજાવો.
